documents.summary: College-wide guidance for teaching, learning and research that requires every instructor to choose one of three syllabus AI statements, sorts AI uses into open, disclosed, overseen and prohibited categories, and requires disclosure and student ownership. It also covers bias, privacy, review and a two-step warning and escalation process.
documents.stance_why: The document sets no single rule. It says "Instructor will select between the three syllabus statements below" (no AI, AI on specific assignments, all AI) and "decisions regarding the use of AI in teaching and learning reside with faculty", and it names the use categories Open Use, Use with Disclosure, Use with Oversight and Prohibited Use. Because it offers tiers and templates and hands the choice to instructors, the stance is delegates. Both coders gave delegates.
